sample_description: S. mansoni schistosomula was from a BH isolate maintained by passage through golden hamster (Mesocricetus auratus) and Biomphalaria glabrata snails. Cercariae were collected from snails infected for 35 days with 10 miracidia each, cooled on ice for 30 minutes to prevent swimming and collected by centrifugation. Schistosomula were obtained by mechanical transformation of cercariae and separation of their bodies by sedimentation. Newly transformed schistosomula (NTS) were maintained in vitro for 72 h and then incubated with plasma from schistosomiasis self-cured rhesus macaques (33% final concentration). NTS were collected, washed with PBS and snap-frozen. For the ChIP-Seq experiment, treated schistosomula were crosslinked using formaldehyde, lysed and sonicated with the Bioruptor Pico for 5 cycles (30s ON and 30s OFF). Sheared chromatin was collected and used on the Diagenode IP-STAR for ChIPmentation (cat #C01011000) according to the User Guide v2 01_02_2018.
experiment_title: NextSeq 550 sequencing: Chromatin immunoprecipitation of H3K27me3 treated with plasma from schistosomiasis self-cured rhesus macaques before infection with S. mansoni

sample_description: S. mansoni schistosomula was from a BH isolate maintained by passage through golden hamster (Mesocricetus auratus) and Biomphalaria glabrata snails. Cercariae were collected from snails infected for 35 days with 10 miracidia each, cooled on ice for 30 minutes to prevent swimming and collected by centrifugation. Schistosomula were obtained by mechanical transformation of cercariae and separation of their bodies by sedimentation. Newly transformed schistosomula (NTS) were maintained in vitro for 72 h and then incubated with plasma from schistosomiasis self-cured rhesus macaques (33% final concentration). NTS were collected, washed with PBS and snap-frozen. For the ChIP-Seq experiment, treated schistosomula were crosslinked using formaldehyde, lysed and sonicated with the Bioruptor Pico for 5 cycles (30s ON and 30s OFF). Sheared chromatin was collected and used on the Diagenode IP-STAR for ChIPmentation (cat #C01011000) according to the User Guide v2 01_02_2018.
